blogs.title: Man's Best Friend? Capnocytophaga canimorsus and the Zoonotic Threat You Can't Afford to Miss
blogs.description: A deep dive into C. canimorsus as an emerging pathogen—its epidemiology, spectrum of presentation from cellulitis to fulminant sepsis, and the diagnostic delays caused by its fastidious, slow-growing nature. This post will cover appropriate empiric antibiotic selection for dog bites, the critical importance of prophylaxis compliance, and why a thorough animal exposure history should be standard in any septic workup.

blogs.title: Beyond the DIC Score: Unmasking Thrombotic Microangiopathy in Sepsis
blogs.description: When TMA hides in plain sight during active sepsis and DIC, how do you know when to look further? This post explores the clinical clues that should prompt suspicion for superimposed TMA—persistent thrombocytopenia despite resolving coagulopathy, new-onset hemolytic anemia, and progressive AKI—and discusses why early recognition is essential for initiating targeted therapy.

blogs.title: The TMA Triad: A Systematic Approach to MAHA, Thrombocytopenia, and AKI
blogs.description: A practical diagnostic algorithm for the adult with thrombotic microangiopathy. This post walks through the critical differentials—TTP (ADAMTS13 activity, PLASMIC score utility), STEC-HUS (clinical prodrome and stool PCR), and CM-HUS (diagnosis of exclusion)—emphasizing time-sensitive testing and why empiric plasma exchange shouldn't delay definitive diagnosis.

blogs.title: Normal C3/C4 Doesn't Rule It Out: The Diagnostic Pitfalls of Complement-Mediated HUS
blogs.description: A focused look at CM-HUS diagnosis—why complement levels can be normal during active disease, the role (and limitations) of genetic testing, the utility of kidney biopsy in confirming TMA, and distinguishing inherited complement defects from infection-triggered dysregulation. Includes discussion of alternative pathway functional assays and when to initiate empiric therapy while awaiting results.

blogs.title: Eculizumab at the Crossroads: Balancing Complement Blockade and Infection Risk
blogs.description: Navigating the therapeutic dilemma of initiating complement inhibition in a post-infectious setting. This post covers timing of eculizumab initiation, mandatory meningococcal vaccination protocols, antimicrobial prophylaxis considerations, and the evidence linking early treatment to renal recovery outcomes—along with practical guidance on duration of therapy and reassessment strategies.
